$description: Alliance AI Partners design tokens (W3C DTCG). Palette from the finalized logo kit (docs/brand-kit/_build/palette.json, 'A, P and the Ribbon'); neutrals and status colours derived for the website, every text pairing checked for WCAG 2.x AA. Compiled to tokens.css and tailwind-theme.css by build-tokens.py.

alliance-blue.$description: The AI in light lockups, the Flat-Light mark, the Mono-White ground, and the lit faces of the 3D A

ribbon-cyan.$description: The ribbon's light in both 3D colourways; the AI and one-colour mark on dark grounds; the descriptor rule

partner-navy.$description: All type on light grounds, the dark ground, and the deepest shadow of the light mark

daylight.$description: Page and panel ground; the paper in print; not a logo ink

pure-white.$description: Paper and knockout: type and the Mono-White mark on navy or blue grounds

partner-30.$description: the P's underside and the shadow band of the A's left bevel (light mark)

partner-38.$description: slate shadow faces of the A's right leg; deepest faces of the dark mark

partner-46.$description: slate mid faces (P bowl, A's right leg); also secondary text on white

partner-50.$description: lifted slate highlights of the dark mark on navy

alliance-38.$description: deep-blue shadow bands on the A under the ribbon (light mark)

alliance-46.$description: blue faces turning into shadow, the ribbon's shaded end; hover/pressed Alliance Blue

alliance-50.$description: the top of the A's left bevel in both colourways

ribbon-57.$description: the ribbon's turn from blue into cyan, in both colourways; lies on Daybreak

0.$description: Cool neutral 0, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 1.07, on white 1.0, on Partner Navy 17.27.

25.$description: Cool neutral 25, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 1.0, on white 1.07, on Partner Navy 16.07.

50.$description: Cool neutral 50, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 1.07, on white 1.15, on Partner Navy 14.98.

100.$description: Cool neutral 100, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 1.16, on white 1.25, on Partner Navy 13.81.

150.$description: Cool neutral 150, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 1.27, on white 1.37, on Partner Navy 12.65.

200.$description: Cool neutral 200, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 1.43, on white 1.53, on Partner Navy 11.26.

300.$description: Cool neutral 300, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 1.8, on white 1.93, on Partner Navy 8.95.

400.$description: Cool neutral 400, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 2.49, on white 2.67, on Partner Navy 6.47.

500.$description: Cool neutral 500, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 3.66, on white 3.94, on Partner Navy 4.39.

600.$description: Cool neutral 600, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 5.14, on white 5.53, on Partner Navy 3.12.

700.$description: Cool neutral 700, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 7.23, on white 7.76, on Partner Navy 2.22.

800.$description: Cool neutral 800, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 10.07, on white 10.82, on Partner Navy 1.6.

900.$description: Cool neutral 900, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 13.11, on white 14.08, on Partner Navy 1.23.

950.$description: Cool neutral 950, derived from Partner Navy toward Daylight. WCAG on Daylight 16.07, on white 17.27, on Partner Navy 1.0.

black.$description: Mono-Black one-ink print work only (K100). Never a screen colour.

raised.$description: Cards, inputs, menus: one step lighter than the page.

inverse.$description: Partner Navy chapters, footer, the dark side of the kit.

scrim.$description: Partner Navy scrim behind modal surfaces.

primary.$description: Body and headings on light grounds. 16.07:1 on Daylight.

link.$description: Links: Partner Navy, always underlined, so colour alone never marks a link. 16.07:1 on Daylight. Alliance Blue is kept for the one action per view.

inverse-secondary.$description: Supporting copy on Partner Navy, tinted from the navy hue rather than grey. 10.55:1 on Partner Navy, 8.39:1 on Partner 30.

inverse-tertiary.$description: Captions and meta on Partner Navy, navy-tinted. 6.99:1 on Partner Navy, 5.56:1 on Partner 30.

inverse-accent.$description: Accent words on Partner Navy. 9.84:1. Ribbon Cyan is never text on light grounds.

strong.$description: Inputs and controls: 3.66:1 on Daylight, 3.94:1 on white (3:1 for UI components).

primary.$description: The one committing action in a view.

primary-hover.$description: Hover: one step down the Alliance ramp.

secondary.$description: Outline and text of secondary actions.

secondary-hover-surface.$description: Hover fill of secondary actions on light grounds.

ring.$description: Focus ring on light grounds (2px, 2px offset).

error.$description: Error text and icons on light grounds (5.18:1 on Daylight).

error-surface.$description: Error message background on light grounds.

success.$description: Success text and icons on light grounds (4.97:1 on Daylight).

success-surface.$description: Success message background on light grounds.

warning.$description: Warning text and icons on light grounds (5.62:1 on Daylight).

warning-surface.$description: Warning message background on light grounds.

info.$description: Info text and icons on light grounds (5.11:1 on Daylight).

info-surface.$description: Info message background on light grounds.

series-3.$description: Third series, on Partner Navy or as a fill with a navy edge.

daybreak.$description: The signature gradient (palette.json signature): hero bands, the ribbon, brand graphics. Never behind small text.

ribbon.$description: The ribbon's turn, Ribbon 57 into Ribbon Cyan.

facet.$description: Top-left light on a raised plane, as on the mark's bevels.

sans.$description: Every heading, body and UI text. Variable: width 75-125, weight 200-900, optical size.

mono.$description: Sourced notes, times, prices in tables, code.

expanded.$description: Display, echoing the wide Montserrat wordmark.

display-xl.$description: The one statement per page. Expanded, tight. 48px at 390 wide to 92px at 1440.

display-lg.$description: Chapter openers. 40px at 390 wide to 68px at 1440.

heading-1.$description: Page titles. 34px at 390 wide to 52px at 1440.

heading-2.$description: Section titles. 28px at 390 wide to 40px at 1440.

heading-3.$description: Sub-sections, card titles. 22px at 390 wide to 28px at 1440.

heading-4.$description: Small headings. 18px at 390 wide to 20px at 1440.

body-lg.$description: Lead paragraphs. 18px at 390 wide to 21px at 1440.

body.$description: Running text. 16px at 390 wide to 17px at 1440.

body-sm.$description: Secondary text. 14px at 390 wide to 15px at 1440.

label.$description: Buttons, form labels, nav. 14px at 390 wide to 14px at 1440.

caption.$description: Captions and meta. 13px at 390 wide to 13px at 1440.

numeral.$description: Prices and figures; tabular lining numerals. 40px at 390 wide to 64px at 1440.

mono.$description: Sources, times, codes; tabular. 13px at 390 wide to 14px at 1440.

section.$description: Vertical padding of a page section, fluid.

md.$description: Raised cards, menus. Light from the top left, as on the mark.

facet-edge.$description: The lit top edge of a raised plane.

in-out.$description: Symmetric moves; mirror it for the return path.

spring.$description: Critically damped spring (damping 1.0, response 0.35 s) for CSS. In JS use Motion: { type: 'spring', bounce: 0, duration: 0.35 }.
